# Offline country/territory data

BIG CTY by Jim Reisert, AD1C, released 15 September 2026. Original CTY.DAT
is included unmodified, with its MIT permission notice in LICENSE.

Upstream: https://www.country-files.com/big-cty/
Pinned source: https://deb.debian.org/debian/pool/main/h/hamradio-files/hamradio-files_20260915.tar.xz
Archive member: hamradio-files/bigcty/cty.dat
SHA-256: 887d44ed2ae0b4f108b1a50672a8fcb6e8fe4c9601a1fdb644269a7e2ce3a646

Country/territory entities are inferred from longest callsign prefixes and
exact exceptions. They describe likely operating entities, not verified live
locations. Maritime/aeronautical mobile and unknown/hashed calls are marked
accordingly. Optional local replacement: ~/.config/icomzero/cty.dat (restart
app to reload; invalid files fall back to the bundled data).
